issues.where: crops 3 and 4, the icicles hanging from the rim band
issues.what: the icicles are flat-shaded resin spikes: smooth gray gradients, blunt rounded tips, no internal refraction, bubbles or scene light passing through them
issues.fix: give each icicle internal structure (bubbles, streaks), sharper tapered tips, and refracted color from the scene behind the glass

issues.where: crop 5, the trees and lamp behind the globe on the right
issues.what: the background trees are flat cutout shapes with a stippled dot texture instead of needles, and the lamp head is dark with no glow or halo
issues.fix: replace with dimensional trees carrying real branch structure, and give the lamp a warm light with falloff on the ground and bench

issues.where: crops 4 and 6, the cobblestone foreground and puddle margin
issues.what: the wet cobbles read as a low-detail model: chunky faceted stones with a speckled plastic sheen, no mortar joints, and water that sits on top without wetting the stone
issues.fix: rebuild the foreground ground with beveled, higher-detail stones, visible joints, and puddles that darken and wet the stone around their edges

issues.where: the mirror image below the base
issues.what: the reflection carries the same heavy blur at the contact line as it does far below, so the base never quite meets its reflection
issues.fix: sharpen the reflection where the base touches the surface and let it soften only with distance

issues.where: crop 12, the slush and foam at the foot of the base
issues.what: the foam is a field of uniform round beads the size of plastic pellets, all one tone
issues.fix: vary bubble size, collapse some cells, and mix in clear ice shards

issues.where: crop 8, the carved band from rim to foot
issues.what: the reindeer and pine relief is so dark and shallow it reads as a printed silhouette rather than carving
issues.fix: deepen the cuts and let the rim light catch the carved edges so the relief reads at a glance

issues.what: the smoke is a smooth tube with a clipped blunt end, not drifting puffs
issues.fix: break the plume into thinning puffs with soft irregular edges

issues.where: crop 1, the frost feathers on the glass at the shoulder
issues.what: the frost ferns sit on the glass like flat white decals, with uniform opaque strokes and no sparkle at the tips
issues.fix: thin the strokes, break the frond tips, and add small crystal glints so the frost catches light
